description: Header file defining the MemoryItemViewModel class, which models a single memory item in a calculator application's ViewModel layer, including properties for position and value, and methods for memory operations.

classes.name: MemoryItemViewModel
classes.description: A sealed class representing a memory item in the calculator's ViewModel, with observable properties for position and value, and methods to clear, add, or subtract memory.

methods.name: MemoryAdd
methods.description: Adds the current value to the memory.

methods.name: MemorySubtract
methods.description: Subtracts the current value from the memory.
